newsitem.title: JAPAN: Poll shows support for Japan PM Hashimoto rising.
newsitem.headline: Poll shows support for Japan PM Hashimoto rising.

text.p: Support for Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's government has surged in the past month, with nearly 45 percent of those surveyed backing his cabinet, according to a poll published on Friday.
The survey by the financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun found that support for Hashimoto's cabinet has risen to 44.9 percent, up 8.8 percentage points from March, when the last poll was conducted.
The number who said they did not support the government fell to 32.6 percent from 37.5 percent, the newspaper said. The rest were undecided.

Supporters of Hashimoto cited the strength of his ruling Liberal Democratic Party, his "reliable personality" and the government's "international perspective" as reasons for supporting the administration.
Those unimpressed by Hashimoto cited "bad policies", "lack of leadership" and "instability" in the government.
The poll, conducted last weekend, did not mention how people evaluated Hashimoto's response to the Peru hostage crisis.
